questions.question:
Statement: All employees of the company must wear ID cards.
Conclusions: I. An employee without an ID card breaks the rule. II. ID cards are given only to employees.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I restates the rule. II is outside information.

questions.question:
Statement: The library is open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays.
Conclusions: I. The library is closed on weekdays at 6 p.m. II. The library is open on Sundays.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: 6 p.m. is outside the opening hours. Nothing is said about Sundays.

questions.question:
Statement: Some students of the college passed with distinction.
Conclusions: I. All students of the college failed. II. At least one student of the college passed with distinction.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: II restates "some". I contradicts the statement.

questions.question:
Statement: Rain has been heavy this year.
Conclusions: I. Crop yield is higher. II. There was rain this year.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: II is directly implied. I adds an assumption.

questions.question:
Statement: No smoking is allowed in the office.
Conclusions: I. Smokers cannot smoke in the office. II. Smoking is allowed outside the office.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I restates the rule. Nothing is said about outside.

questions.question:
Statement: Ravi scored 80 and Meena scored 75.
Conclusions: I. Ravi scored more than Meena. II. Meena is weaker than Ravi in every subject.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: 80 > 75. Subject-wise performance is unknown.

questions.question:
Statement: Only graduates are eligible to apply for the post.
Conclusions: I. A non-graduate cannot apply. II. All graduates will get the post.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: Eligibility does not mean selection.

questions.question:
Statement: All the trains to Chennai from this station leave before noon.
Conclusions: I. No train to Chennai leaves this station after noon. II. There are many trains to Chennai.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I restates the statement. The number of trains is not given.

questions.question:
Statement: Mina is taller than Rina, and Rina is taller than Tina.
Conclusions: I. Mina is taller than Tina. II. Tina is the shortest of the three.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: Mina > Rina > Tina, so both follow.

questions.question:
Statement: The use of plastic bags has been banned in the city.
Conclusions: I. Shopkeepers cannot legally give plastic bags. II. All pollution will end.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I follows from the ban. II is an unsupported claim.

questions.question:
Statement: Every student of class X must take either Science or Commerce.
Conclusions: I. A class X student who takes neither is not following the rule. II. Class X students cannot take both subjects.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I follows. The statement does not forbid taking both.

questions.question:
Statement: In the examination, 90% of the candidates passed.
Conclusions: I. 10% of the candidates did not pass. II. The examination was easy.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: 100% − 90% = 10%. Difficulty is not stated.

questions.question:
Statement: Neither Ravi nor Kiran attended the meeting.
Conclusions: I. Ravi did not attend the meeting. II. Kiran attended the meeting.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: Neither means both were absent.

questions.question:
Statement: Few people in the town own a car.
Conclusions: I. Most people in the town do not own a car. II. Many people own cars.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: Few means a small number, so most do not.

questions.question:
Statement: The company announced that it will not give a bonus this year.
Conclusions: I. Employees will get no bonus this year. II. The company is making losses.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I restates the announcement. The reason is not given.

questions.question:
Statement: All the doctors in the hospital are on strike from tomorrow.
Conclusions: I. Patients will not get treatment from the hospital's doctors tomorrow. II. The hospital will be shut permanently.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I follows. II goes far beyond the statement.

questions.question:
Statement: The price of onions rose by 20% last month. This month the price fell by 20%.
Conclusions: I. The price now is the same as two months ago. II. The price now is less than it was two months ago.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: 1.2 × 0.8 = 0.96, so the price is lower, not equal.

questions.question:
Statement: Among five boys, Ram is not the tallest and Shyam is taller than Ram.
Conclusions: I. Shyam is the tallest. II. Ram is not the shortest.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: Others may be taller than Shyam, and Ram could be the shortest. Neither is certain.

questions.question:
Statement: Each of the 40 students of a class has opted for at least one of English and Hindi.
Conclusions: I. No student has opted for neither subject. II. Every student has opted for both subjects.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I restates "at least one". II is not stated.

questions.question:
Statement: The bank has decided to open branches in all villages with a population over 5,000.
Conclusions: I. A village with 6,000 people will get a branch. II. Villages with 3,000 people will not get a branch.
Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: I follows. The statement does not rule out other branches.
